input.summary: Limit audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' notice, business hours, independent confidentiality-bound auditor, off-site records review, and delete remote system access.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have limited audits to once in any twelve-month period on thirty days' prior written notice, during business hours, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, and conducted as an off-site records review; unannounced audits and remote access to our systems are not something we can accept, and the latter also conflicts with the access restrictions already in Section 22.2. If timing is a concern, we can move to fifteen days' notice.

ops.oldText: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
ops.newText: 22.1 No more than once in any twelve (12) month period, and on at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, Vendor may audit Customer's use of the Services solely to verify compliance with this Agreement, during Customer's normal business hours and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer's operations. Each audit shall be conducted by an independent auditor engaged at Vendor's cost and bound by written confidentiality obligations no less protective than those in this Agreement, and shall be carried out by off-site review of records and reports provided by Customer. Neither Vendor nor its auditor shall have any direct or remote access to Customer's systems.
